title: Bawd
summary: BAWD, noun [Gr., a procurer or procuress.] A procurer or procuress. A person who keeps a house of prostitution, and conducts criminal intrigues. [Usually applied to females.] BAWD, verb intransitive T

inlines.v: BAWD, noun [Gr., a procurer or procuress.] A procurer or procuress. A person who keeps a house of prostitution, and conducts criminal intrigues. [Usually applied to females.] BAWD, verb intransitive To procure; to provide women for lewd purposes. 1. To foul or dirty. [Not in use.] BAWD'-BORN, adjective Descended from a bawd
